title.ja: 君がいて僕がいる（Safe Zone）- GMMグラミー オールスターズ [OFFICIAL MV]

transcript.text: บอกไม่ได้ว่าฉันรักเธอเท่าไร ก็ไม่มีคำไหนที่จะดีพอ เท่าจักรวาลที่ช่างกว้างใหญ่

translations.en: I can't express how much I love you, no words could ever be enough. Even the vast universe
translations.ko: 내가 널 얼마나 사랑하는지 말로 다 할 수 없어, 그 어떤 말도 충분하지 않지. 광활한 우주조차도

translations.id: Aku tak bisa katakan seberapa besar ku mencintaimu, tak ada kata yang cukup baik, bagai luasnya alam semesta
translations.pt: Não consigo expressar o quanto te amo, não há palavras boas o suficiente, nem mesmo o vasto universo

translations.zh-TW: 也依舊顯得太小。好希望妳能一直待在這裡，陪我好久好久，一輩子或是一百萬年好嗎？

translations.pt: ainda seria pequeno demais. Queria que você ficasse aqui comigo por muito tempo, para sempre ou por um milhão de anos.

translations.en: Just having your support, won't you promise not to disappear? You are my everything,
translations.ko: 여전히 날 지지해 주는 네가 있어 준다면, 사라지지 않으면 안 될까? 넌 내가 가진 모든 사랑이야
translations.zh-TW: 只要有妳一直支持著我，妳可以不要消失嗎？妳就是我全部的愛
translations.id: Hanya dengan memiliki dirimu yang terus mendukungku, maukah kau tak pergi? Kamulah satu-satunya cinta yang kupunya
translations.pt: Só de ter você me apoiando, por favor, não vá embora. Você é todo o amor que eu tenho

transcript.text: และรักจะอยู่ที่ตรงนี้ จะอบอุ่นแบบนี้ นี่แหละคือ safe zone

translations.en: and love will stay right here, warm like this, this is our safe zone.
translations.ko: 그리고 사랑은 바로 이 자리에 있을 거야, 이렇게 따뜻하게. 바로 이곳이 안전지대(safe zone)
translations.zh-TW: 而愛會一直都在這裡，像這樣溫暖，這就是我的 safe zone
translations.id: Dan cinta akan berada di sini, akan sehangat ini, inilah zona amanku (safe zone)
translations.pt: e o amor vai ficar bem aqui, aconchegante assim, isso é uma zona segura.

translations.ko: 널 잘 돌봐주고 싶어, 네가 여기 오래오래 있어 주길 바라. 다정한 그 눈빛
